family.selection: The 55-vertex mandatory-overlap graph reconstructed from every retained prime tile whose exact subgroup order n divides 55440.

method.certificate: For each excluded root vertex, orient six integral units from every mandatory edge to its endpoints so the root receives zero and every other vertex receives exactly 91. Each orientation proves 6*|E(S)| <= 91*(|S|-1) for every selected set S containing that root.
method.theorem: If all 55 root-excluding orientations verify and the full graph has 819 edges, then the exact maximum of |E(S)|/(|S|-1) over all |S|>=2 is 91/6, attained by the full graph.

nonclaims: This is not an unbiased discovery episode because the expected ratio and null direction were seen in unretained exploratory work.
A no-conclusion result is not evidence that the selected family can cover.
The certificate qualifies only unweighted mandatory-pair graph bounds, not weighted, prime-power, or higher-order arguments.
This does not resolve Erdos problem 203 globally.
This producer analysis is not a Vela Verification or human Decision, and it changes no scientific Standing.

preknowledge.disclosure: An unretained exploratory calculation suggested that the full graph attains 91/6 and that the resulting overlap inequality remains cover-compatible.
preknowledge.effect: The iteration receives no Claim credit. Its value is a replayable exact certificate and an honest closure of one method lane.

stopping_rule: After this preregistration is committed, run the frozen producer once and the independent checker once. Retain the exact graph-local ratio and comparison whether the result is a bounded exclusion or no conclusion. Any byte drift, missing orientation, source mismatch, or checker failure is invalid output.
